plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, explains the Mandela effect, named because a big group of people say they remember Nelson Mandela, the South African leader, dying in prison in the 1980s, though he later walked free. Michels brings it up in a talk about the idea that we live in a kind of hologram, where shared false memories might be signs that reality itself can shift.
